surface.name: Google Cloud Gemini model API quickstart
surface.selection_basis: Google's cloud model quickstart includes project, billing, API enablement, IAM, authentication, and a first model request, which is materially different from the Gemini Developer API.

alternatives_considered.name: Gemini Developer API
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: It is tracked in the direct API cohort because AI Studio can create the project and key automatically.

alternatives_considered.name: Partner models in Model Garden
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: Partner-model deployment adds model-specific access and deployment choices.

entry_point.developer_intent: Configure a Google Cloud project and receive a Gemini model response through the cloud model API.
assumed_prior_state: No Google Cloud project, billing link, enabled API, IAM grant, or credential exists.
A browser and terminal are available.

documented_first_success.official_milestone: Send a request to a model
documented_first_success.normalized_outcome: An authenticated Google Cloud model API request returns Gemini-generated text.
documented_first_success.observable_completion_signal: The SDK or REST response contains generated model output.

boundary_evidence.official_label_or_terminal_state: The current cloud getting-started guide proceeds from project prerequisites and authentication to a model request and response.

documented_first_success.why_this_is_the_boundary: The first returned model text is meaningful, while cloud project, billing, API enablement, IAM, region, and credentials remain part of this platform's starting boundary.

prerequisites.requirement: A Google Cloud account and project.
The documented generative AI API enabled in the project.
Required IAM permissions for model access.
An API key or Application Default Credentials for the selected route.

primary_path.action: Create or select a Google Cloud project and link billing.
primary_path.input: Google Cloud account and billing account
primary_path.success_signal: The project is active with billing.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Account, organization policy, or billing setup can block the project.

primary_path.action: Enable the required model API and select the project location.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: API enablement permissions or region availability can block setup.

primary_path.action: Grant the required IAM role and create the selected credential.
details: The guide supports API key or Application Default Credentials paths.
primary_path.success_signal: The client can authenticate to the project.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: IAM propagation or policy restrictions can delay access.

primary_path.action: Send the documented text request to a Gemini model.
primary_path.input: Project, region, credential, model, and prompt
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Credential, permission, quota, region, model, or request errors block output.

primary_path.action: Confirm generated text is present in the response.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: An error body is not first success.

branches.condition: The developer chooses Application Default Credentials instead of an API key.
branches.path: Authenticate the local environment with Google Cloud credentials and IAM.
branches.effect_on_first_success: Changes credential setup and may add local CLI steps.

friction_gates.description: A billable Google Cloud project is required.
API enablement and location selection are required.
IAM and credential setup are required.

sources.title: Get started with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform models

uncertainties.question: Should the maintained product label remain Vertex AI after Google's current documentation route and navigation changes?
uncertainties.impact: Affects product identity and durable URL approval.
uncertainties.reason_unresolved: The historical Vertex AI quickstart redirects into Google's current Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform model documentation.
